landing.page_description: A modern Laravel base template built with Tailwind CSS, DaisyUI and Alpine.js.
landing.hero_subtitle: A clean, modern starting point for your next Laravel application. Themed, responsive and ready for real screens — so you can skip the boilerplate.
landing.features_subtitle: The essentials are wired up and following Laravel conventions, so the first feature is never far away.
landing.feature_tailwind_desc: CSS-first configuration with the Vite plugin. No config file, no build headaches.
landing.feature_daisyui_desc: A full component library built on semantic color tokens you can theme in seconds.
landing.feature_themes_desc: A persisted theme toggle that respects the operating system preference by default.
landing.feature_alpine_desc: Sprinkle behaviour straight into Blade with drawers, dropdowns and toggles.
landing.feature_components_desc: Buttons, cards, badges and layout shells ready to compose into real screens.
landing.feature_laravel_desc: Routing, testing with Pest and Pint formatting already wired up and ready.
landing.theming_subtitle: Every color comes from semantic DaisyUI tokens. Adjust the custom themes in :file and the entire UI updates instantly.
landing.cta_subtitle: Jump into the dashboard shell and start shaping your application.
